caption: The drawing depicts a suspended sculpted head, colored in varying shades of brown, suggesting it is made of a stone or clay-like material. The head features distinct human facial characteristics, including closed eyes, broad nose, pronounced lips, and subtly defined ears. The hair appears textured with short, rounded patterns etched across the top and sides of the head. The surface of the head shows several cracks, dents, and rough spots, indicating signs of wear or age. At the top center of the head, a chain consisting of two thick, interlinked, dark loops is attached, giving the appearance that the head is hanging from above. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or detailing, emphasizing the head and chain as the sole subjects of the drawing.
title: Carved Wooden Head
